description: Renovate keeps THE TEMPLATE itself up to date. This is the OPPOSITE of the config shipped to projects
(templates/repo/.github/renovate.json), and for the SAME reason — where the versions live decides.
In a GENERATED project: the pins live in .github/workflows/. Dependabot covers the `uses:` there
and pip; Renovate ONLY does the curl-ed binaries there (hence `enabledManagers: custom.regex` there).
HERE: all of the template's versions live under `templates/` — a TEMPLATE FILE, not an active workflow.
Dependabot `github-actions` is LOCKED to the repo's `.github/workflows/`: it NEVER reaches
`templates/workflows/`. So there is NO dependabot.yml on this repo: it would be blind.
Renovate carries EVERYTHING — actions + binaries + pip — because it alone can scan an arbitrary path.
⚠ `github-actions` ONLY scans `.github/workflows/` by default: the `managerFilePatterns` below
EXTEND its reach to `templates/`. `pip_requirements` finds requirements-ci.txt on its own (Renovate
scans the whole repo). `custom.regex` has no default: its pattern MUST point at templates/.
⚠ FAILURE MODE: an unknown key makes Renovate REJECT the config and STOP ALL PRs, IN
SILENCE — nothing fails, the PRs simply stop. Validate every change: `renovate-config-validator`.
⚠ The `v` prefix on `*_VERSION` (v8.30.1, NOT 8.30.1) is MANDATORY: the
`github-release-attachments` datasource resolves the digest via GET /releases/tags/{currentValue}. Without `v` → 404,
Renovate gives up, no PR — without breaking anything visible. (renovatebot/renovate#27317.)

packageRules.description: Minor/patch bumps are grouped into one PR. MAJOR versions stay isolated: a scanner's major version changes the rules, hence the findings — that's reviewed alone.

description: renovate-config-validator: auto-merged. It ships ~6 times a DAY — pinned exact, it
would produce a mechanical PR every Monday, to review for nothing. It's a CI LINT tool,
never shipped to runtime, and its auto-merge is GUARDED by the CI that runs it: if an
upstream version regresses, `validate-renovate` goes red and the PR does not pass. This is exactly
the failure mode (a validator that LIES) the `>= 43` floor targeted — here it's caught
BEFORE `main`, instead of being suffered there.
renovate-config-validator, pinned EXACT. It comes from npm, not a GitHub release:
no `currentDigest` here — an npm version is IMMUTABLE, the checksum adds nothing.
The pin itself is necessary: `renovate@43` resolved the latest 43.x on EVERY RUN, so
`main` could go red without a line changing. A float does NOT only give the fixes:
it also gives the regressions, right away, and WITHOUT a known-good version to fall back to.
⚠ `check.sh` carries the same version — it is IN the managerFilePatterns for that reason.
